description: The common-multiplatform @CreateComponent factory must be public and must use the expect modifier: a private factory and a non-expect factory are each rejected, with renamed component and package.

sources:
package com.app

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.AppScope
import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.MergeComponent

@MergeComponent(AppScope::class)
interface AppGraph

@MergeComponent.CreateComponent
private expect fun createGraph(): AppGraph

cases.expected_output:
status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=Factory functions for components annotated with `@CreateComponent` must be public.

sources:
package com.app

import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.AppScope
import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.MergeComponent
import software.amazon.lastmile.kotlin.inject.anvil.MergeComponent.CreateComponent
import kotlin.reflect.KClass

@MergeComponent(AppScope::class)
interface AppGraph

@CreateComponent
fun KClass<AppGraph>.createGraph(): AppGraph

cases.expected_output:
status=rejected
error=invalid_usage
reason=Only expect functions can be annotated with @MergeComponent.CreateComponent. In non-common Kotlin Multiplatform code use the generated `create` extension function on the class object: YourComponent.create(..).
